title: The Quintupling Glass Wasps
story: In the cold moonlit aviary of Spindlecrest Tower, Velloquin the Glass Wasp Queen buzzes behind a chandelier. Every time a sword taps a glass wasp it shatters into 5 smaller glass wasps — so swinging is the worst possible plan. Mr 6 starts with 4 wasps circling him and decides to count before he acts.
question: If every wasp is struck once each round for 3 rounds, how many glass wasps would be buzzing at the end?
solution: Round 3: 100 x 5 = 500 wasps — which is why Mr 6 sheathes his sword instead.
praise: Multiplying by 5 was exactly right — the trick was doing it once for each of the three rounds.
hint: Each round multiplies the whole swarm by 5. Try writing out the count after round 1, then round 2.
victory: Mr 6 lowers his sword, hums a low note, and the glass wasps settle onto it like a chiming necklace. Velloquin, charmed by a knight who counts before he swings, leads her swarm out the window in a ribbon of moonlight.
imagePrompt: A moonlit glass aviary filled with shimmering translucent wasps around a crystal chandelier, with a small number 6 knight thoughtfully sheathing his sword instead of swinging.
